lines.say: blocks SGLT2, so more filtered sugar leaves in the urine
blood sugar falls in type 2 diabetes
slower kidney decline and fewer deaths in chronic kidney disease, with or without diabetes
fewer cardiovascular deaths and heart failure hospital stays in heart failure
kidney function checked; a small early eGFR dip is expected, then steadies
ketoacidosis, even with near-normal blood sugar; ketones checked if suspected
dehydration, low blood pressure and acute kidney injury, more so in older adults
genital yeast and urinary infections; rare serious ones include Fournier's gangrene
